method: Official article, repository, and archive metadata pages were checked without downloading source payloads.

observed_metadata: The article is High-Throughput Investigation of Diverse Junction Elements in RNA Tertiary Folding.
The public article record identifies a tectoRNA high-throughput measurement system.
The reported design includes 1328 junction sequences and 359 sequences characterized by X-ray crystallography.
The paper uses 1x1 and 2x2 nomenclature within a broader junction library and provides supporting information links.
required_next_checks: reconcile raw/interpolated/censored values and reported counts

observed_metadata: The article reports 7500 RNA constructs containing two-way junctions with known 3D structures.
The article identifies PDB files on Figshare and demultiplexed FASTQ files under SRA BioProject PRJNA1188187.
The reported quality filtering removes sequences with fewer than 2000 reads or signal-to-noise ratio below 4, and excludes individual measurements with z-scores above 3.
The reported motif canonicalization puts the longer strand first and alphabetically orders equal-length strands.
The article reports four reactivity normalization strategies, including no-modification, denatured, construct-average, and common-hairpin references.
required_next_checks: download JSON supplement, Figshare files, and metadata only through the approved data route
record payload SHA-256, version, and license/terms
reconcile treated/background/read-depth hierarchy and construct IDs
verify connected-component and construct split groups before any model use

not_done: No checksum was computed for a source payload.
No license was treated as verified.
No motif matching, manual 50/30 audit, or matching accuracy estimate was run.
No primary label was admitted to a modeling table.
